N1.s: Използвахте всичките %lld безплатни Кътлинга. Продължете в Кътлинг, отключете го и новият ще се запази.
N1.back: You-used all-the 5 free Cutlings. Continue in Cutling, unlock it and the-new-one will itself save.
N1.why: The first sentence is S3's, word for word. 'Го' is masculine for the app, and 'новият' (the new one) can only be the item, so the two never blur. 'Ще се запази' is the plain reflexive future a person says. 100 characters.

N2.s: Използвахте всичките %lld безплатни Кътлинга. За още отворете Кътлинг и го отключете.
N2.back: You-used all-the 5 free Cutlings. For more open Cutling and it unlock.
N2.why: Same opening as N1 and S3. 'За още' (for more) is everyday Bulgarian and keeps it under budget; after 'и' the clitic 'го' goes before the verb. 82 characters.

N3.why: 'Запазено' is the impersonal status word Bulgarian iOS shows after a save. 'Място за' repeats S6's 'Място за %@ Кътлинга', and masculine 'един' points at a Кътлинг. 'Има място за още един' is the idiom, cut to fit the capsule. 27 characters.

N4.why: 'X от Y' as in S5 and S29, and 'заети' (taken, like seats) as in K1, so the places are full and nothing is lost. The same words open N5, so the bar reads as the next step. 22 characters.

N5.s: %1$lld от %2$lld заети. Отключете, за да се запази
N5.back: 5 of 5 taken. Unlock, so to itself save
N5.why: Starts with N4's status. Formal 'Отключете' as in K1, the keyboard's other tappable message. 'За да се запази' says the item is saved by unlocking, with no 'we'. 40 characters.

N6.why: The same button word as S15: Bulgarian buttons use the informal singular imperative, like the vocab's 'Продължи'. 7 characters.

N7.s: Използвахте всичките %lld безплатни Кътлинга. Отключете Кътлинг и този ще се запази.
N7.back: You-used all-the 5 free Cutlings. Unlock Cutling and this-one will itself save.
N7.why: S3's opening again. 'Този' (this one) points at the item shown in the form below, and since that item is itself a Кътлинг the word reads true either way. 81 characters.

N8.s: Този Кътлинг ви чака. Отворете приложението, отключете го и той ще се запази.
N8.back: This Cutling you waits. Open the-application, unlock it and it will itself save.
N8.why: 'Ви чака' (is waiting for you) says it was kept, warmly, like the dashed sixth tile on the sheet. 'Приложението' avoids putting the item word and the app name side by side; neuter 'го' is the app, masculine 'той' is the item. 77 characters.
